## Youth-GEMS

Scores draw on the consortium's website and project pages [@prbb2023;
@youthgems_research; @youthgems_decisions2025; @youthgems_expert2025] and one
conference abstract [@youthgems_earma2024]; no peer-reviewed output exists yet.
Young Experts shaped the app's wording and visuals (A2 = ◐) and help create
social-media content, but the consortium set the research questions and
explicitly excluded them from building and validating the AI model (A4 = ○).
With a design role but no role in choosing the question, the case is classed as
participatory science. The project is ongoing (D1 = ●) and has no results yet
(C3 = NR), so the verdict is insufficient evidence.
